titulo: Russian strikes target Ukraine's Kharkiv and Sumy regions, killing at least six
cuerpo: At least six people were killed in Russian strikes on Ukraine overnight into Thursday, including three in the city ​of ‌Balakliia in the Kharkiv region and another three in the northern region of Sumy, local authorities said. A Russian ​attack also damaged ​a foreign-flagged ship loaded with wheat in Ukraine's Black ​Sea area late on Wednesday, according to Odesa's regional governor.
